import google.generativeai as genai
import os
import json

api_key = os.environ.get('GEMINI_API_KEY')
if not api_key:
    print('ERROR: GEMINI_API_KEY not set')
    exit(1)

genai.configure(api_key=api_key)

model = genai.GenerativeModel('gemini-2.0-pro-exp')

prompt = 'Epic space opera movie poster, collage style mix of action scenes and character closeups. Heroes and villains in dramatic confrontation. Contemporary realism photorealistic style with highly rendered focal points and abstracted peripheral areas. Meticulous textural realism using smooth tightly blended gradients. Precise shadows defining three-dimensional volume. Pyramidal composition. Thick solid white border frame on solid black background. Various collage elements explode outward from the border in dynamic burst. No text. Cinematic lighting, 8k resolution, movie poster quality.'

response = model.generate_content([prompt])
print('Generated:', response.text[:200] if hasattr(response, 'text') else str(response))
